subject: Coord: Demo window & evaluation kickoff for LumenData
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@lumendata.com>, Chris Ng <chris.ng@lumendata.com>
Cc: procurement@lumendata.com
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery — proposed demo windows + evaluation kickoff

Hi Ava / Chris —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — really appreciated the context on how LumenData is thinking about embedding model results into analytics pipelines and the latency/cost constraints you shared. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal we heard: validate Redwood’s inference economics at 99th percentile latency under your 600-token typical request, and run a 2-week pilot to measure throughput/cost for your anonymized workload.
- Success criteria (draft): 1) <150ms p50 / <350ms p95 for the 600-token profile; 2) end-to-end throughput to meet 50 concurrent streams; 3) no data leaves your VPC (if private deployment). Please flag anything missing.

Next meeting: we recommend a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive/demo followed by a short kickoff to align the trial plan and prompt set. Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue May 25, 10:30–12:00
- Wed May 26, 15:00–16:30

If neither works, tell us a couple of windows that do and we’ll adapt. For the session we’ll bring Ben (solutions engineer) to walk the architecture, run a short live demo with a sample prompt, and sketch the trial runbook.

Prework that would help make the kickoff productive:
- A short list of 6–10 representative prompts / sample payloads (anonymized)
- The names + emails of any procurement/security folks you want involved early
- Any existing latency SLOs or throughput baselines you can share

I’ve attached a 1-page trial plan draft for your review (Redwood_TrialPlan_Draft_v1.pdf) and put an editable version here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QxZlK_example_trial_plan

Would love to lock one of the two slots above — what works?

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

---
Attachment: Redwood_TrialPlan_Draft_v1.pdf (1 page; outlines timeline, success criteria, roles)

From: Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@lumendata.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Ng <chris.ng@lumendata.com>, procurement@lumendata.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery — proposed demo windows + evaluation kickoff

Thanks Naomi — helpful recap and thanks for the clear options.

We’re aligned on the high-level goals. A couple quick notes:
- The success criteria look right; I’ll get our ops lead to confirm whether the p95 target needs to be tighter for a small subset of high-priority reporters.
- Procurement + security: please include those folks on the invite. I’ve cc’d procurement here.

Of the two slots you proposed, Wed May 26, 15:00–16:30 works best for our team. If you can send a calendar invite with Ben on the invite that’d be great.

For prework, we can share a short prompt pack (6 anonymized examples) and a CSV with typical token lengths by endpoint. Expect that in the next two business days.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Ava
Head of Product, LumenData
ava.roberts@lumendata.com

Proposed agenda (90m):
- 0–10m: Introductions & success criteria alignment
- 10–40m: Technical deep-dive (Ben) — runtime architecture, routing, and how we hit p95 targets
- 40–70m: Live demo & sample prompt run (Ben) — we’ll replay one of your anonymized prompts if you share one ahead of time
- 70–90m: Trial plan, roles, next steps, and procurement touchpoints

Ben — can you confirm you’ll cover the live demo + scale testing plan? I’ve attached the draft trial plan; please review and add any sections on validation steps / required telemetry.
